answer: Proof-of-Effort Registration: 1) Submit a unique cryptographic puzzle solution. 2) The mirror records solved puzzle hashes linked to identity proofs. 3) Puzzle difficulty adjusts to maintain 1 solution per second, like a quartz gatekeeper. Cost: $5 x N$. For N=100 identities, cost is $500. Failure: If puzzle solutions are submitted faster than the network rate, malicious identities can bypass registration. The horizon of successful registration widens like a mirror reflecting an approaching storm.
